{
  "reasoning": "The user explicitly requested two independent actions: book a flight AND book a hotel. The model issued only one tool call (flight_book) when the ground truth required both flight_book and hotel_book to be invoked in parallel.",
  "error_identification": "Missing hotel_book tool call. The model recognized the flight booking requirement but failed to recognize and act on the hotel booking requirement in the same turn.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model appears to have parsed the request incompletely, focusing on the first instruction (flight booking) and omitting the second independent instruction (hotel booking). This suggests insufficient attention to compound requests with multiple distinct actions separated by 'and'.",
  "correct_approach": "When a user request contains multiple independent actions (e.g., 'book X and book Y'), invoke all relevant tool calls in parallel within the same turn. Parse the full request for all actionable items before generating tool calls.",

}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".

  {"type": "MODIFY", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
  {"type": "REMOVE", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>"}
